entities.name: Dainius Šalenga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dainius Šalenga is a Lithuanian retired professional basketball player. He is a small forward that is mainly known for his three–point shooting abilities. Šalenga represented the senior Lithuanian national basketball team at the 2004 Summer Olympics.
